entities.name: Query HPr kinase/phosphorylase
observations: 309 aa soluble enzyme; predicted molecular weight 35.08 kDa and theoretical pI 6.53.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A6TVI5, an HPr kinase/phosphorylase from Alkaliphilus metalliredigens.
Contains Pfam Hpr_kinase_N (PF02603) at residues 4–127 and Hpr_kinase_C (PF07475) at residues 130–298.
Catalyzes ATP- or pyrophosphate-dependent phosphorylation of HPr Ser and phosphate-dependent phosphorolytic dephosphorylation of phospho-HPr.
Requires Mg2+ according to the matched curated annotation and is annotated as a homohexamer.
Engages in carbon catabolite repression by controlling HPr phosphorylation, PTS carbohydrate uptake, and inducer exclusion.

entities.name: HPr phosphocarrier protein
observations: Protein substrate of HPr kinase/phosphorylase; its active-site serine is reversibly phosphorylated or dephosphorylated in the PTS regulatory pathway.

entities.name: PTS carbon catabolite repression
observations: HPr kinase/phosphorylase regulates the phosphorylation state of HPr, thereby modulating PTS-mediated carbohydrate uptake and carbon catabolite repression.
